【On-chain anomaly: $72 billion in ETH exposed to quantum attack risks】

Nearly 55% of unstaked ETH is held in wallets whose public keys are visible. In practical terms, whales, stakers, exchanges, and cross-chain bridges could all be affected. If quantum-resistant upgrades fall behind, the security costs for custodians and bridges will have to be recalculated. ETH’s supply has grown at an annual rate of 0.90% since mid-2025, close to BTC’s 0.82%. Scarcity supports value, but security risks eat into the premium—this business can’t run on faith alone.

【FNG is just 11, yet ETH hasn’t kept collapsing】

ETH is down 65% from its ATH, and 5.3% over the past seven days. It’s up a slight 0.6% in the past 24 hours, while trading volume has surged abnormally to more than 5% of its market cap. Historically, an FNG reading near 11 has often signaled a bottom, but extreme fear is never a guarantee that the bottom is in; often, there’s a sharp sell-off first, followed by wild swings. I saw the same old shakeout tactics dressed up in new clothes in 2017. Sentiment indicators can’t protect your principal.

Are whales quietly building positions? The on-chain data available so far shows no evidence of sustained accumulation or net outflows from exchanges, so we can’t just make up a story about “smart money moving in.” The prerequisites for buying the dip are that panic stops spreading, selling pressure dries up, and the scarcity narrative and security fundamentals remain intact. Miss even one, and you could be catching a falling knife.

You talk about going all in, but your hands are steadier than anyone’s. Would you dare to buy this dip?

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What’s the Fuel Cost of a Blockchain?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay a Gas fee to transfer funds or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transferring funds, trading, running a
contract) consumes computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel cost.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the price per unit of Gas).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → soaring Gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operations can cost half as much.

📰 Why is Wall Street bullish on Nvidia, and why has Citi set a $240 price target?

On November 23, Nvidia’s board voted unanimously to bring CEO Jensen Huang back to three roles. Several Wall Street investment banks moved quickly: Bernstein upgraded the stock from “Market Perform” to “Outperform,” Melius changed its rating from “Hold” to “Buy,” and Citi raised its price target directly from $225 to $240. Why has Huang’s return made Nvidia shares so popular?

Why does this news matter?
This personnel change is not an isolated event. First, as the driving force behind Nvidia, Huang’s technological vision and execution are key supports for the company’s stock price. Demand for AI computing power has surged recently, and Nvidia is the undisputed leader, but internal power struggles (such as CEO turnover) had at one point worried the market. The move by Wall Street investment banks is essentially saying, “Huang is back, and the commander of the AI battlefield is back in place.” This gets to the core question of whether Nvidia can continue to lead the AI hardware race.

Market impact
In the short term, a boost to Nvidia’s share price could lift the entire AI hardware sector, especially AI service providers that rely on Nvidia chips. More fundamentally, if Nvidia manages to maintain its technological lead in AI, it will reinforce the market’s belief that “AI is the engine of the future economy.” This shift in narrative could drive money out of traditional tech stocks and into AI infrastructure. As a historical reference, the semiconductor sector saw a similar trend after Apple released its M-series chips in 2021.

💡 Bernstein and Citi’s rating upgrades mean they are bullish on Nvidia’s long-term share of the AI computing market. But that view would be invalidated if Nvidia’s future earnings fall short of expectations (for example, if Qtr1 revenue comes in below $100B).

title: USDT为什么能锚定1美元？稳定币的运转原理
subTitle:
玩合约离不开USDT，但很多朋友没想过它凭什么值1美元。

【原理】稳定币由发行方运营：你给它1美元，它发给你1个USDT，并把
美元（及等值资产）存进储备。市场上谁想把USDT换回美元，就向发行
方赎回。这套「申购-赎回」机制像锚一样，把价格钉在1美元附近。
价格偶尔偏离一点点（比如0.999），套利者马上搬砖抹平。

【要关心的风险】储备透明度。USDT定期公布储备报告（含美债等资产），
但历史上稳定币圈出过事——储备不够的稳定币脱锚崩掉，持有人血本
无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Why is USDT pegged to $1? How stablecoins work
translatedData.subTitle:
It’s hard to trade futures without USDT, but many people haven’t wondered what gives it its $1 value.

【How it works】The stablecoin is operated by its issuer: you give it $1, and it issues you 1 USDT, while putting
dollars (and equivalent assets) into its reserves. Anyone in the market who wants to exchange USDT back for dollars can contact the issuer
redemption. This “mint-redemption” mechanism acts like an anchor, keeping the price close to $1.
The price occasionally deviates slightly (for example, to $0.999), and arbitrageurs quickly bring it back in line.

一、以太坊市场走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月二十三日，以太坊报价一千七百五十五美元，过去二十四小时价格区间为一千七百三十美元至一千八百四十五美元。以太坊此前受机构买盘推动一度冲高至一千八百一十美元上方，但随后回落至一千七百五十美元附近震荡。当前价格位于布林带中轨一千七百三十七美元上方，上轨压力位于一千七百八十八美元，下轨支撑位于一千六百八十六美元。整体来看，价格在中轨和上轨之间窄幅整理，方向选择临近。

均线系统方面，七小时均线位于一千七百六十三美元，二十五小时均线位于一千七百三十三美元，九十九小时均线位于一千七百美元。三条均线呈多头排列，短中长期趋势仍然向上。但价格已跌破七小时均线，短线存在回调压力。指数移动平均线显示七周期为一千七百五十三美元，价格在其附近徘徊，多空力量暂时均衡。超级趋势指标维持在一千七百二十八美元，为短期提供支撑参考。

二、技术指标深度解读

随机相对强弱指标读数为十点零七，已深入超卖区域，短期反弹概率较高。相对强弱指标六周期读数为四十五点五四，处于中性偏低水平，尚未进入超卖但已接近。威廉指标读数为负七十七点一一，确认短期超卖。KDJ指标中J值降至十六点四四，K值为三十四点九三，D值为四十四点一七，三线向下发散但已接近低位区域。

MACD方面，柱状图读数仅为零点二六，接近零轴，多头动能已明显衰竭。MACD线为十四点一四，信号线为十三点八八，两者差距极小，随时可能出现死叉。这是需要重点关注的风险信号。ATR指标读数为二十四点二七，波动率维持在中等水平。标准差指标从三十五点九降至十五点四三，显示价格波动正在收窄，通常预示着即将出现方向性突破。

三、市场情绪与基本面分析

从基本面来看，BitMine公司新增购入七千八百一十九枚以太坊，总储备达到六百零九万枚，约占流通供应量的百分之四点九八。这一大规模机构买入为以太坊价格提供了坚实的需求底部。更为重要的是，目前已有百分之三十六点三的流通供应量被质押，总计约四千四百五十万枚以太坊被锁定在质押合约中，且质押队列中还有超过九十万枚以太坊等待加入。这种大规模的供应锁定显著减少了市场上的浮动筹码。

然而风险同样不容忽视。主要以太坊ETF发行商累计流出超过一百万枚，持续的机构赎回构成结构性卖压。同时，超过八万五千五百枚以太坊被存入交易所地址，短期内可能增加抛售风险。此前相对强弱指标曾达到九十点五的极度超买水平后回落至四十五点二，确认了在布林带上轨附近的获利回吐压力。

宏观面上，币安即将上线传统金融永续合约和Anthropic股票期权交易，显示加密市场与传统金融的融合正在加速。本周PCE通胀数据将是影响以太坊短期走势的关键事件。综合来看，以太坊基本面强劲但短期技术面偏弱，建议关注一千七百三十美元支撑和一千七百八十八美元阻力的突破方向。

ETH retreats to around $1,740 | Liquidity in Sky stablecoin swap pool recovers | I’m waiting for confirmation at $1,765

I welcome the recovery in on-chain liquidity, but I wouldn’t use it as a reason to chase ETH. A topic appeared on Binance Square: #SkyPSMUSDCLiquidityReboundsTo$1.77B. I checked Sky’s public ecosystem dashboard: the snapshot at 04:03 UTC on November 23 showed about $1.758 billion in USDC held by LitePSM, roughly 28.3% of the combined USDS and DAI supply. That is below the dashboard’s indicated target of about $1.87 billion, a difference of roughly $108.4 million. Another Sky collateral page showed about $1.753 billion on the same day, but with a different snapshot time and measurement methodology. The $1.77 billion figure in the topic can be understood as an approximation; the small differences between pages shouldn’t be interpreted as a sudden influx of funds, and it would be wrong to say that this USDC represents the entire Sky system’s reserves.

The PSM’s mechanics matter more than the numbers. Sky explains that LitePSM provides a 1:1 conversion route between USDC and USDS or DAI, and that its liquidity buffer can support arbitrage and large conversions when stablecoins deviate from their peg. This matters for settlement confidence among Ethereum DeFi users: if the conversion route remains smooth, stablecoin risks for related lending and trading applications may ease. But this USDC is a reserve in a stablecoin conversion pool, not a direct purchase of ETH, and it doesn’t prove that spot ETH ETFs have shifted from outflows to inflows. Anyone who sees the word “recovery” and concludes that ETH must rise is skipping over three links: stablecoin demand, on-chain activity, and ETH value capture. I’ll keep watching whether the PSM balance remains stable, whether the USDS price deviates from its peg, and what happens to on-chain fees, rather than focusing on a single snapshot.

The market also hasn’t confirmed a sustained move higher. The latest Kraken ETH/USD quote is around $1,739.79, with a 24-hour open of $1,721.61, a low of $1,693.91, and a high of $1,843.93. The price briefly surged to around $1,844 intraday, then fell back by about $100; this move can’t be directly attributed to the Sky data. $1,765 is the short-term level I’m watching to see whether the rebound can regain its footing, while $1,844 is further overhead resistance. A drop below $1,690 would invalidate my short-term recovery thesis; a break above $1,765 followed by a quick drop back to $1,740 would also indicate insufficient buying support. ETF flows and Wednesday’s U.S. PCE data remain independent risks that can’t be offset by a single piece of positive DeFi news.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter now. I’d only consider a small, unleveraged spot long. I’d wait for a four-hour close above $1,765, a retest that holds near $1,760, and no further significant decline in the Sky dashboard balance before entering with at most 1.5% of my total capital. My first target would be $1,800, where I’d sell half; my second target would be $1,840, where I’d sell half of the remainder. I’d place a stop below $1,725 and close the position immediately if it’s triggered. If there’s another large net outflow from the stablecoin conversion pool or ETH falls back below $1,760, I’d exit proactively even if the stop hasn’t been reached. If these conditions aren’t met, I’d stay out of the market. #SkyPSMUSDCLiquidityReboundsTo$1.77B #ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH回落至约1740美元｜Sky稳定币兑换池流动性回升｜我只等1765确认

我的态度是认可链上流动性修复，但不据此追买ETH。币安广场出现话题#SkyPSMUSDCLiquidityReboundsTo$1.77B。核对Sky生态公开仪表盘：11月23日04:03 UTC的快照显示，LitePSM所持USDC约17.58亿美元，约占USDS与DAI合计供应量的28.3%，低于仪表盘标示的约18.7亿美元目标，差约1.084亿美元。另一个Sky抵押品页面同日显示约17.53亿美元，快照时间和统计口径不同。话题里的17.7亿美元可理解为近似表述，不能把不同页面的小差额解释成瞬时新增资金，更不能写成整个Sky系统储备仅有这笔USDC。

PSM的机制比数字更值得看。Sky官方解释，LitePSM提供USDC与USDS、DAI之间的1:1兑换路径，流动性缓冲有助于稳定币偏离锚定价时的套利与大额兑换。这对以太坊DeFi用户的结算信心有意义：若兑换通道顺畅，相关借贷和交易应用的稳定币风险可能缓和。可这笔USDC是稳定币兑换池储备，不是直接买入ETH，也不能证明ETH现货ETF已由流出转成流入。用户若只看到“回升”两个字便推导ETH必涨，跳过了稳定币需求、链上活动和ETH价值捕获三个环节。我会继续观察PSM余额是否稳定、USDS价格偏离和链上手续费，而不是只看单一快照。

市场目前也没有给出持续上攻的确认。查询Kraken ETH/USD时，最新约1739.79美元，24小时开盘1721.61，低点1693.91，高点1843.93。价格盘中曾冲至1844附近，随后回落约百美元；此波动不能直接归因于Sky数据。1765是我观察反弹能否重新站稳的短线位置，1844是更远的上方压力。若跌回1690以下，短线修复判断被推翻；若突破1765后很快跌回1740，也说明买盘承接不足。ETF资金与周三美国PCE数据仍是独立风险，不能用一条DeFi好消息覆盖。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只考虑无杠杆现货小仓试多。等四小时收盘站上1765美元、回踩1760附近不破，且Sky仪表盘余额没有再次明显下降，才用总资金最多1.5%入场。第一目标1800美元，达到后减半；第二目标1840美元，再减剩余的一半。止损放在1725美元下方，触发立即平仓。若稳定币兑换出现新的大额净流出或ETH重新跌破1760，即使未到止损也主动退出；若条件没出现，就保持空仓。#SkyPSMUSDCLiquidityReboundsTo$1.77B #ETH

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Staying Flat Is a Position Too—and It’s the One the Pros Use Most
translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have is that not holding a position means you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market swings grind away their capital.

In fact, staying flat is the only position with zero losses. If you can’t read the market, stay flat.
Stay flat when bulls and bears are battling, or after a few losing trades in a row—the money you save at these three moments,
is more than most people make from trading.

You may be tired of the hunting analogy, but the point is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. Keep your capital intact, and when an opportunity comes, you’ll have ammunition. Hold on to your bullets.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own performance. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went right or wrong (in execution), and
what you’ll do differently next time (a specific action). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover that your losses...
Your trade log is full of the same mistakes repeated over and over—for example, immediately reversing after a stop-loss,
or never letting winning trades run.

The market changes, but your behavioral patterns won’t change on their own unless you keep an eye on them and work to change them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade history is your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—go through your trading records.

Think back to the first half of the year—just how frenzied was the hype around memory chips and optical modules, which was everywhere? You could see people going all in on Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Weibo, and X, saying it was the best year of their lives.

Even influencers who had never traded stocks were showing off their positions and flaunting their market savvy, oblivious to the danger.

Our government was so alarmed that it quickly tightened channels for outbound investment. They know this crowd too well: in the end, one by one, they’d be left stranded at the top with nothing…

I said it then: whoever jumped in could end up being the last one left holding the bag.

When the capital market runs short of money, it needs to find new stories and side plots. And so, a semiconductor theme swept the entire East Asian semiconductor supply chain into the frenzy.

From institutions to retail investors, from industrial capital to ordinary investors, people borrowed money and piled on leverage—even betting the wages they’d earn over the next few years.

And the result?

After one market rally, the shares had changed hands.

The capital market never runs out of stories; what it lacks is real money willing to be the last one left holding the bag.

The cruelest part is that insiders completed the transfer of their positions, while retail investors used their own hard-earned money to pay for others to get out.

Once the U.S. completes its industrial reshuffling over the next two or three years, institutions will also fall one after another in the process.

That’s just how the world works

Let’s review the circumstances around Old Huang’s departure. First came the “spy scandal,” and Huang apologized. Then came the “executive scandal,” and Huang resigned.

I think most people knew on the day he left that he’d be back.

I posted at the time:

America can accept losing Jensen Huang, the graphics-card guy.

But America’s capital markets can’t accept losing Jensen Huang, who is carrying revolving debt.

Old Huang has taken the U.S. capital markets hostage.

Three things made it inevitable he’d return.

You could see it in Trump’s tone, too. On day one, Trump said: “Let Cook become Nvidia’s CEO.”

The next day, the U.S. Treasury began assessing Nvidia’s debt structure. There were even claims that Nvidia might be holding America hostage with debt.

After that, both parties fell silent, and the public discussion started to die down.

America’s capital markets could probably scrape together the hundreds of billions of dollars in revolving credit Nvidia needs. But you can’t afford to lose confidence in debt. A few hundred billion dollars is small potatoes—the real issue is the rolling over of trillions of dollars in debt behind it.

Debt piled on debt is a defining feature of the current AI bubble. No one dares to poke it; one poke and it bursts.

Debt interest rates above 8% have already appeared in America’s AI sector.

It’s crazy—you could call it a bubble fueled by debt.

【Fear Index at 11, Yet On-Chain Supply Is Barely Growing】

Since mid-2025, ETH’s annual supply growth rate has been just 0.90%, nearly matching BTC’s 0.82%. The Fear & Greed Index is at a frigid 11, while new supply is tightening noticeably. This divergence is more worth watching than the 2.3% gain over the past 24 hours.

But let me be clear: these data don’t include changes in whale holdings, net exchange flows, or active addresses, so I won’t mislead anyone with claims of “whale accumulation.” A genuine mid-term signal requires all three to align: net outflows from exchanges, a recovery in active addresses, and trading volume that isn’t driven by short covering. Volume has already exceeded 5% of market cap, so a major move may be near—but there’s still no proof of who’s buying.

There’s another, more concrete on-chain risk: around 55% of unstaked ETH is exposed in wallets with visible public keys, putting roughly $72 billion in value across those addresses at risk from future quantum attacks. In practical terms, exchanges, custodians, and staking providers will all need to pursue post-quantum migration, and hardware wallets, bridges, and operating organizations will also be affected. There’s real commercial demand for security upgrades, but migration costs and operational risks won’t simply disappear.

ETH is down 65% from its ATH; 1,662 is support, and 1,875 is resistance. There are signs of a bottom, but the trend hasn’t been confirmed. On-chain data doesn’t lie—what do you think? Is this a recovery after coins were locked up, or a high-volume bull trap?

At 1:30 a.m., the more I stared at the charts, the more frustrated I got. That huge pump after dinner almost had me thinking it was about to take off—then, in the middle of the night, it gave us the old give-it-all-back routine.

First, take a look at the $ETH 1-hour chart. It suddenly shot up at 9 p.m., then at 10 p.m. volume surged to nearly $200 million as it hit 1,845.07. The calls of “breakout!” in the group chat were going wild. But the excitement lasted less than 15 minutes before a long upper wick poured cold water on things, followed by four straight bearish hourly candles sliding lower. It’s now at 1,756.89, back below the MA7 (1,762.46). At least volume quickly dried up again, while the MA25 (1,732.73) and MA99 (1,700.96) are still providing support below. That $670 million in 24-hour turnover wasn’t for nothing.

The $UNI 4-hour chart is even more amusing. It climbed from 4.188 and surged on heavy volume to 5.312, and now it’s caught its breath right at the 5.004 threshold. The MA99 (5.634) is still a long way overhead, while the MA7 (4.826) and MA25 (4.703) have just moved up underneath to offer support.

These spike-and-retrace moves are the most agonizing: chasing feels awkward, but staying out feels risky in case it resumes its rally after shaking everyone out. Is this a fake breakout and a sell-off, or a pullback to the moving averages to shake out weak hands? Hard not to agonize over it. I’ll place an order and get some sleep. Not investment advice. translatedData.title: Trading Discipline | Five Rules I Keep by My Screen—Sharing Them Just as They Are
translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, we forget every lesson, so I wrote these down and stuck them up where I can see them:

1. Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
2. Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
3. Never add to a losing position or average down.
4. After three consecutive losing trades, stop for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
5. Withdraw part of your profits. The money you take out is cash; what you leave behind is peace of mind.

That’s all five. Not one is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never
that they misread the market—it’s that their execution breaks down. Let’s keep each other accountable.

content:
For once, ETH led the bounce instead of following it.

It ran from Saturday's $1,538 low all the way to $1,845 today — about 20% in two days — then slipped back to ~$1,766. That tag and the pullback say the same thing: buyers are back, but $1,826-$1,850 is a real wall.

And here's the odd part. The ETF money still isn't helping — spot ETH ETFs lost $305.8M over five sessions last week, $131.2M on Thursday alone, a fifth straight day of outflows. ETH went up anyway.

Shorts paid for it too: $33M of the $37M in ETH liquidations today were shorts getting squeezed. RSI bounced from 22.6 to 35.4 — still oversold, but breathing again.

Honestly, the 7th straight weekly loss is already in the books, so this bounce has to prove itself. Hold $1,700 and $1,800 is next. Lose $1,697 and it's back to the weekend's mess. BTC ~$62,600 meanwhile, and the fear index is still stuck at 11.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | Getting Rich Slowly: What Compounding Really Looks Like in Crypto
translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly keep their money in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earn just 1% a day, and over 250 trading days a year, that’s 12 times your money. Earn a steady 10% a month,
and you’ll have 30 times your money in three years. It doesn’t sound thrilling, but here’s the magic—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. You wait for the right market conditions, but discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the first goal comes from the market,
but the ability behind the second is yours. The market opens every day, but only those who preserve their capital are qualified to keep playing.

translatedData.content:
BlackRock has seen net outflows of 1.019 million ETH since October 1, worth about $1.75 billion at current prices. On the same day, ETH was trading at 1,760.87, up 2.24% over 24 hours, with trading volume of 9555M USDT. The largest spot channel has been selling steadily, yet the price is rising. The fact that both things are happening at once is, in itself, the most valuable signal in this rally.

First, let’s look at who isn’t buying. The perpetual futures funding rate is -0.0006%, settled every eight hours—three times a day—which works out to about -0.66% annualized. A negative funding rate means shorts are paying longs. With the price rising while the rate is negative, longs haven’t paid any premium for this move, so leveraged longs probably aren’t driving the rally. ETFs aren’t behind it either. The $1.75 billion in spot selling pressure has been absorbed by capital that uses neither ETFs nor leverage.

Next, look at the positioning. Open interest is 4.052 billion USDT, and 67.4% of accounts are long. These two figures are interesting together: nearly 70% of accounts are bullish, yet the funding rate is negative. In other words, measured by notional value, the short side has larger positions, with big money on the short side. But those traders haven’t pushed the price down in response to ETF outflows; instead, they keep paying funding costs. In this setup, guessing the direction based on the number of accounts is basically guessing the opposite.

So where did that $1.75 billion worth of ETH go? ETH traded 9555M USDT in a day, more than five times the cumulative outflows in this period, so the market can easily absorb the supply. The key is that after absorbing it, the price still held on to a 2.24% gain, while the funding rate remained negative. If buyers planned to flip their ETH within a few days, this combination wouldn’t hold. A more plausible explanation is that the coins have moved into wallets that don’t intend to sell in the short term—for example, staking, DeFi collateral, or long-term holders. These coins don’t participate in intraday price setting. This is an inference; on-chain data doesn’t show the full flow, but the current combination of price action and funding rates supports only this explanation.

There’s another development that’s easy to overlook: Russia has allowed exchanges to offer crypto trading, and the Moscow Exchange aims to launch a pilot on December 1. As US channels see net outflows, non-US regulated channels are opening up. It’s too early for this to be priced in, but it means the marginal demand for ETH could come through a different channel in the future—a development worth noting.

The risk is right here, too. This is a rally without conviction behind it: funding is so close to neutral, and 4 billion in open interest isn’t much relative to the market cap. Neither side is willing to make a serious directional bet. A move driven by trading volume rather than positioning can swing both ways. If ETF outflows continue to accelerate, or a large collateralized position gets pushed close to liquidation, a pullback needs no further catalyst. ⚠️ A negative funding rate doesn’t mean it’s safe; it only means nobody is willing to pay to take a directional position right now.

My approach is to neither chase longs nor open shorts at this level. I’m watching three things: when the funding rate turns positive—that would be the first sign of real longs entering; whether BlackRock’s outflows narrow; and whether the 4 billion in open interest grows along with the price. I’d only act if two of the three move in the same direction.

content:
贝莱德从10月1日到现在净流出101.9万枚ETH，按现价折算约17.5亿美元。同一天，ETH报1760.87，24小时涨2.24%，成交9555M USDT。最大的现货通道在持续卖货，价格却在往上走。这两件事同时成立，本身就是这波行情最有价值的信息。

先看谁不在买。永续资金费率-0.0006%，每8小时结算一次，一天三期，折年化约-0.66%。负费率意味着空头在付钱给多头。价格在涨、费率是负的，这说明多头没有为这波涨幅付过任何溢价，所以这波抬价大概率不是杠杆多头推动的。ETF也不在其中。那17.5亿美元的现货卖压，被既不经过ETF、也不借杠杆的资金接走了。

再看持仓结构。持仓量40.52亿USDT，多头账户占比67.4%。这两个数放一起就有意思了：账户层面接近七成看多，费率却是负的。也就是说，按名义本金算，空头那一侧的单子更大，大资金站在空的一边。但它们没有顺着ETF流出往下砸，反而在持续付持仓费。在这个结构里，用账户数猜方向，基本等于猜反。

那17.5亿美元的货去哪了。ETH一天成交9555M USDT，比这波累计流出还大五倍多，市场完全吃得下。关键是吃完之后价格还能站住2.24%的涨幅、费率还留在负值区——接盘方如果打算几天内倒手，这个组合撑不住。更合理的解释是筹码进了不打算短期动的口袋，比如质押、DeFi抵押、或者长线地址，这类筹码不参与日内定价。这属于推断，链上看不到完整流向，但目前的价格与费率组合只支持这一种解释。

还有一条容易被忽略的线：俄罗斯放行交易所提供加密交易，莫斯科交易所目标12月1日启动试点。当美国通道在净流出，非美合规通道在开门。这件事现在还不到定价阶段，但它意味着ETH的边际需求未来可能换一条渠道，值得记一笔。

风险也在这里。这是一次没有信念支撑的上涨：费率浅到接近中性，40亿的持仓量相对这个市值体量并不重，多空双方都不愿意为方向真正下注。成交驱动而非仓位驱动的行情，弹性是双向的，ETF流出如果继续放大，或者某个大额抵押仓位被推近清算线，回撤同样不需要理由。⚠️ 负费率不代表安全，它只代表现在没人愿意为方向付费。

我自己的处理是：这个位置不追多也不做空，盯三件事——费率什么时候转正，这是真多头进场的第一个信号；贝莱德的流出是否收窄；40亿的持仓量会不会跟着价格一起放大。三条里同向出现两条，才值得动手。
